sections.heading: Welcome aboard Queen Elizabeth
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide, not affiliated with Cunard. Queen Elizabeth is known for art deco interiors, the Garden Lounge and elegant onboard spaces.

sections.heading: Official ship and deck plans
sections.body:
Official Cunard Queen Elizabeth ship information and interactive deck plans (internet required): https://www.cunard.com/en-gb/cruise-ships/queen-elizabeth
Select a deck on Cunard's official website for current locations.

sections.heading: Deck reference
sections.body: Check the current Cunard deck plans for staterooms, lifts, facilities and accessible routes. Ship information can change.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Dining includes Britannia Restaurant, Britannia Club, Princess Grill, Queens Grill, Lido Restaurant, Steakhouse at The Verandah, Golden Lion, Café Carinthia and the Wellness Café. Main dining arrangements depend on stateroom grade.

sections.heading: Bars and lounges
sections.body: Explore the Commodore Club, Garden Lounge, Midships Bar, Golden Lion, Yacht Club, Café Carinthia and other lounges. Check the daily programme.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Royal Court Theatre, Queens Room, Yacht Club, casino, deck games and Cunard Insights activities; programmes vary by voyage.

sections.heading: Wellness and outdoor spaces
sections.body: Mareel Wellness & Beauty, Pavilion Pool, Lido Pool, Games Deck, Grill Suites Terrace and the Wellness Café.

sections.heading: 2025 refurbishment
sections.body: Queen Elizabeth received refreshed public spaces and Grills facilities for her 2025 season. Read Cunard's official article: https://www.cunard.com/en-gb/cunard-stories/queen-elizabeth-reimagined

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check passports, visas, travel insurance, luggage labels, embarkation instructions and Cunard's latest travel requirements.

sections.heading: First day onboard
sections.body: Find your stateroom, review muster arrangements, check your dining allocation and consult the daily programme.

sections.heading: Ports and excursions
sections.body: Record your port plans, meeting points and official all-aboard times.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Personal notes are stored on your device. External Cunard links require internet access. This app is not connected to onboard systems.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Unofficial independent guide, not endorsed by or affiliated with Cunard. Confirm current information and prices with Cunard.
